problem_hypotheses: The fixed 60-point and 7.5-percent threshold rejects sparse supported roofs and minor planar components.
Density-biased, clipped mean loss hides spatially localized roof-elevation errors.
The enclosing rectangle overfills some nonrectangular observed silhouettes.
Unbounded sloping-plane extrapolation can cross an inferred base; the base itself remains uncertain.

evidence.facts: 73 and 67 roof candidates versus required support 60; both report No roof plane supported.
Observed p95 2.660379 and 2.056518, coverage 0.799995 and 0.446458; broad stable roof Z support suggests omitted local elevations.
ECD 3.905528 and 3.319170; observed coverage alone does not establish correct height or outline.

images.observation: Rectangular inferred roofs omit concave outline changes; input lacks reliable full-height evidence compared with development GT. Used to motivate conservative silhouette change and reject ground-height fabrication.

4914914 misses elevated local roof blocks; 5100005 has no inferred mesh. Used to motivate support recovery and spatially balanced roof scoring; this proposal does not claim to reconstruct stepped roof blocks.

code_changes: Lower plane support to max(18,3 percent); require two-dimensional inlier spread.
If initial extraction fails, merge k=12 stable normal candidates with inclusive elevation quantile and allow 0.15 plane tolerance.
Weight roof support cells equally and add a capped 90th-percentile residual penalty to hypothesis selection.
Use observed convex hull when its area is 60-96 percent of the original rectangle and point count is at least 100; enforce CCW winding.
On below-base corner extrapolation, reselect only planes above the same provisional observed base; raise if none is supported.
Record activated recovery, actual footprint rule, selection rule and base uncertainty.
expected_benefits: Recover supported sparse roofs without arbitrary fallback slabs.
Reduce domination by densely sampled regions and large localized roof errors.
Reduce some nonrectangular footprint overfill while preserving convex assembly.
Avoid unsupported negative roof-to-base height without absolute-Z logic.
risks: Reduced support can select noisy small planes; footprint and selection changes may regress successful cases.
Convex hull remains unable to preserve concave footprints or courtyards and can be outlier sensitive.
Local step roofs remain unsupported by the single convex lower envelope.
Base-relative guard can reject data where low returns do not represent a true base; it does not estimate terrain.
Heuristic thresholds and benefits are untested; topology is not proven by syntax checking.
not_adopted: No ground set to zero, absolute-Z rejection, or GT-derived height extrapolation.
No concave alpha boundary from missing returns: scanner visibility is unavailable.
No local roof domain and internal step-wall rewrite within this bounded proposal.
No evaluator modification, structural-edge protocol change, runtime GT, building-ID special cases or output-result access.
invariants: run(num), ROOT and OUT interfaces retained.
Only input XYZ used at inference; source coordinates retained.
Closed convex assembly retained; no topology or quality claims without parent evaluation.

budget_actual.tool_count_basis: 3 exec_command plus 2 view_image plus 1 collaboration status message; functions wrappers excluded
